scope: Existing active Bedashing branches only. Recompute the same public-proxy scorecard with named, bounded weights.
guardrails: Scenarios do not change source data, peer groups, labels thresholds, confidence, or branch status.
Scenarios do not estimate demand, revenue, profit, customer behavior, or closure decisions.
Weights must each be between zero and one and sum exactly to one.

scenarios.label: Reputation priority
scenarios.description: Places more relative emphasis on public reputation within the same venue-context peer group.

scenarios.label: Competitor-pressure priority
scenarios.description: Places more relative emphasis on the limited two-brand competitor-pressure lower bound.

scenarios.label: Network-spacing priority
scenarios.description: Places more relative emphasis on lower geometric overlap with the existing Bedashing network.
